description: Set the max bid (account currency) on an ad squad that uses a max bid. Refused above the absolute limit (SNAP_MAX_BID), above +50% per step and per 24 hours (SNAP_MAX_BID_INCREASE_PCT), and on auto-bid squads. Previews unless confirm=true. Two steps: confirm=false returns a preview and an approval_token; to apply, repeat the same arguments with confirm=true and that approval_token. Use to change one ad squad's max bid. Not for the bid strategy (snap_set_bid_strategy).

adsquad_id.description: Ad squad id. Get it from snap_list_adsquads.

approval_token.description: The approval_token returned by the preview of this exact request. Required with confirm=true.

bid.description: Max bid in account currency, for example 2.5. Limited by SNAP_MAX_BID.

confirm.description: false = preview only (nothing sent). true = apply; needs approval_token from the preview.

name: snap_set_bid
